title: </sub>  Define one metric for comparative cost claims
text:
</sub>  Define one metric for comparative cost claims

When the matched control covers the required ten or more pull-request heads, this permits a claim that the sweep changed cost but defines no aggregation or comparison rule for the recorded per-pass model-call and elapsed-time values. The same evidence can therefore produce conflicting conclusions depending on whether an implementer uses a mean, median, paired-head deltas, or another statistic; name the cost metric and direction rule before allowing this comparative claim.
